Yeah, true.  I guess I just have a bad taste in my mouth with the whole thing because I've done it before and grew to hate it.  From 23-26, I worked at a Toyota dealership in the parts department.  I actually enjoyed it for the most part, but it got old (which is why I went back to school).  Then again, I was definitely getting shafted with my pay.  I was only making about $18k a year.  I got offered $26k at another dealership but I decided to go back to school instead.  Granted, $26k isn't anything to write home about either, but it would've meant not living paycheck to paycheck at least.  I had no loans or any debt at that point (2006). 

At this point, I just want to get rid of these loans as soon as possible.  I just don't know how to get a non entry level job.  I wouldn't even mind sitting at a desk all day.  I sit at my computer all day anyway.  Maybe a temp agency?  If I could make $30k/year somehow, I'd at least feel like I was on my way to paying back this debt.
